jess: FYI scheduling retention backfill + index rotate on profile_events during maintenance window 2026-04-10 01:30-02:30 UTC. Job streams ~6M rows across 4 shards; will require a short quiesce (~2-5min) before index swap.

 omar: What's the service pin? we should pin workers to v2.4.2 and freeze deploys to that tag during the holdpoint.

 jess: Pin set to v2.4.2. Holdpoint: stop writes at 01:50 UTC, validate and swap index at 01:55 UTC. Rollback: restore safepoint `snap_profiles_pre_backfill_3456789012` and run `/deploy rollback 3456789012`.

 deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by jess for 3456789012 at 2026-04-10T01:35:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 3456789012`. To abort running job: `/deploy abort <job-id>`.

 lina: Canary on shard-3 for 7 minutes, then stagger other shards. Feature flag `profile_ttl_cleanup=true` during run. Canary pass criteria: no lock >4s, replica lag <2s, write p99 <180ms.

 oncall-ops: Adding temporary alerts for `profiles:long_lock>4s` and `replica_lag>2s`. Paste preflight queries?

 omar: Preflight: `SELECT count(*) FROM profile_events WHERE last_active < now() - interval '365 days';` Lock check: `SELECT pid, query, wait_event, state FROM pg_stat_activity a JOIN pg_locks l USING(pid) WHERE l.mode LIKE '%Exclusive%' AND a.state<>'idle';`

 deploy-bot: canary started on shard-3 (job jb_20481). Logs: https://deploy/logs/jb_20481. Monitor `/deploy status jb_20481`.

 jess: Logs look stable so far. Lina please confirm replica lag and lock durations.

 lina: Replica lag 0.5s, locks transient <1.5s. Proceed to shard-1 at 01:45 UTC.

 omar: Emergency stop: `/deploy abort jb_20481` then `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%profile_backfill%' AND state<>'idle';`

 deploy-bot: jb_20481 finished SUCCESS, duration 9m, ~1.6M rows processed.

 jess: Rollout proceeding. Final runbook and release-note snippet updated with rollback steps and contacts. Go/no-go closed. Thanks all :tada:
